experimental_data_source: LaRocco et al. 2025, Fig 5 (shiitake mycelium I-V)
finding: The Ca²⁺ model fits LaRocco's experimental I-V curves with RMSE=0.03948, r=0.8318. The optimized τ_w=4s is in the biophysical range. Power-law scaling is preserved with α=0.861, r=0.9949 against the HP memristor reference.
